t.6834-92-0.agn: The pure substance is corrosive (Skin Corr. 1B); in dishwasher tablets the statement on the label depends on the concentration.
t.6834-92-0.reg.clp: EU binding (harmonised) classification, CLP Annex VI index no 014-010-00-8 (CLP00): STOT SE 3, Skin Corr. 1B.
t.6834-92-0.what: Dissolves greasy dirt, softens water and protects machine parts against corrosion.
